newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean president shelves plan to visit Europe.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean president shelves plan to visit Europe.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam has shelved a plan to visit three European countries and Turkey in March because of domestic woes, his aides said on Tuesday.
"President Kim planned to visit Hungary, Poland, Turkey and Italy in early March but this plan has been indefinitely postponed," a presidential spokesman said.
The spokesman did not give any reason but other officials at the presidential Blue House said the decision was made because of "domestic problems".

South Korea's second largest steelmaker, Hanbo Steel Co, failed under a mountain of debt totalling about $5.8 billion, triggering a scandal which the opposition has called the biggest financial irregularity in the country's history.
The scandal has embarrassed Kim's government which is already on the defensive in an election year after a botched effort last month to reform labour laws.

The opposition accused the government of peddling influence to pressure banks into offering the astronomical loans to Hanbo Steel. Kim's ruling party said the opposition was spreading unfounded rumours in the run-up to presidential elections in December.
